en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a busy central square with many parasol-covered market stalls, a prominent statue on a pedestal, street trams, and rows of historic multi‑storey buildings with shops and signs. In the background a steep wooded hill rises, topped by a clock tower. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene as the Hauptplatz with Schlossberg in Graz, and the publisher Erika‑Verlag from Graz.
